title: Projectiles, ruleset v0
description: Read by GodGame.Sim.Rules.RulesetLoader, which rejects unknown keys; integers only, units in the file's $comment (spec S2). A stone (crushRadiusMm or launchRadiusMm) also takes minRangeMm, scatterNearMm, scatterFarMm, crushRadiusMm and launchRadiusMm (spec S2 6.4), all mm.
